as_read: One small ALS pilot at 2 g/day on riluzole has a positive primary outcome; the stored PBC study has no placebo arm, MS clinical outcomes were null, and labels print 250 to 500 mg with no purpose.
stop_list: Fields can't say the positive primary outcome sits at 2 g/day as add-on to riluzole in ALS while labels print 250 to 500 mg with no purpose
clinician_items: 8674405: diarrhea was the only side effect in 24 PBC patients at 500 to 1500 mg/day.
37842553: 7 of 86 ALS patients (8.1%) stopped TUDCA for side effects, mainly mild gastrointestinal; 2 adverse events required hospital access and resolved.
40236400: transient dyspepsia was the most common side effect in an open-label UC study.
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on 8674405, which has no placebo arm, names no primary outcome and compares only doses. Its outcome text is accurate, but topic_match_verified is false.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. Second search returned 88, printed newest 25 of them, 2023 onward; none is a results paper for phase III TUDCA-ALS (NCT03800524) and I did not look further, so its outcome is unread and is not described here. The older 63 hits were not listed; 25664595 and 20522594 were fetched by PMID from memory of the citation and their titles confirmed live. PMID 20484134 was a wrong guess, unrelated (military diabetes cohort), not used.
